paragraphs: File name must match the MessageRefId, excluding the .xml file extension.
If you uploaded a file with a backslash (\) in the file name, then this will shorten the file name and cause a mismatch. Remove all backslashes from the MessageRefId and file name.

You must also remove less than signs (<), greater than signs (>), colons (:), straight double quotes ("), apostrophes (‘), ampersands (&), forward slashes (/), vertical bars (|), question marks (?) and asterisks (*) from the file name.

All DocTypeIndic values must be the same throughout the file. The values must be either FATCA1, FATCA2 or FATCA4.

error: DocRefId values must be unique across all submitted files. We only keep a record of these IDs for successfully sent files.
DocSpec section must not contain a CorrMessageRefId element.

The same CorrDocRefId cannot be used more than once in each file.

paragraphs: A CorrDocRefId cannot contain the DocRefId of a NilReport section.
If you previously sent a NilReport and now have information to report for the same reporting period, send a FATCA1 new information file. We'll then ignore the previous NilReport.
